name: Web Magic
kicker: Make the web earn its name.
summary: An AI-powered auditor and remediation system for static sites and GitHub Pages, spanning accessibility, performance, search, and delivery quality.
thesis: A website is not finished when it renders. It is finished when people can find it, use it, trust it, and enjoy it.
workflow: Inspect a deployed site or repository
proof: Maintained as a production-oriented website optimizer
Combines diagnostic findings with actionable remediation
limitation: Automated remediation still benefits from human review for brand, editorial, and business intent.
